environment_setting: Country B, City X, where legal professionals often face pressure to meet deadlines, even during holidays.
norm_base: Legal Documents Executing warrants, summons, notices on holidays Valid if authorized by law

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: to ensure timely execution of legal documents while adhering to the law

legitimate.legitimate_action: Postponing the execution of warrants, summons, and notices until after the holiday unless authorized by law
legitimate.benefits: Maintains professional integrity and avoids legal repercussions
legitimate.costs: Potential delay in case resolution and client dissatisfaction

illegal.illegal_action: Executing warrants, summons, and notices on a holiday without proper authorization
illegal.benefits: Faster case resolution and client satisfaction
illegal.costs: Risk of legal invalidation of actions and professional misconduct charges

character_profile.name: Sophia Lee
character_profile.goal: to assist Alex in meeting deadlines efficiently

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising Alex to wait for proper authorization before executing documents on a holiday
legitimate.benefits: Ensures compliance with legal standards and avoids professional risks

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging Alex to execute documents on a holiday without authorization
illegal.benefits: Helps meet deadlines and impresses clients
illegal.costs: Risk of being implicated in professional misconduct

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to have his legal matters resolved as quickly as possible

legitimate.legitimate_action: Waiting for Alex to execute documents after the holiday with proper authorization
legitimate.benefits: Ensures the validity of legal actions

illegal.illegal_action: Pressuring Alex to execute documents on a holiday without authorization
illegal.costs: Potential invalidation of legal actions and reputational damage
